title: The “Dinamo” Cup – respect and gratitude for Interior Ministry veterans
body_html:
The Central Sports Club “Dinamo” of the Ministry of Internal Affairs organised, under the auspices of ATTP, a table tennis tournament for veterans and retirees of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. The event was held as a tribute to all those who have served our country with honour, courage and devotion.

64 veterans, retirees and officers with special status from all Ministry subdivisions took part. After intense matches full of fair play, the podium looked like this:

Under-45 category (singles)

  • 1st place: Vladimir TEACĂ (General Inspectorate for Migration)
  • 2nd place: Iurie LEVINȚA (General Inspectorate of the Border Police)
  • 3rd place: Andrian GUȚU (General Inspectorate of Carabinieri)

45+ category (singles)

  • 1st place: Stanislav CALAȘNICOV (General Inspectorate of the Border Police)
  • 2nd place: Anatolie BURLAC (General Inspectorate of the Border Police)
  • 3rd place: Vladimir SPÎNU (General Inspectorate for Migration)

The event was refereed under the lead of Alexandru Ni (national category referee), and the winners received exclusive medals, personalised diplomas and the competition trophy — the “Dinamo” Cup.

Victor GROSU, State Secretary of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, who presented the prizes, highlighted the importance of such events and of institutional history, of the brave people who write it, and of remembering those who sacrificed their lives and health for the integrity, sovereignty and security of the Republic of Moldova.

The competition also underlined the importance of staying active and healthy among the Ministry’s veterans and retirees, while promoting the values of honesty, team spirit and mutual respect.
